# Thanks for wanting to contribute!

We build changes ourselves from issues, so we do not merge pull requests here, even small fixes or translation corrections.

The most helpful next step is a [detailed issue](https://github.com/inkeep/open-knowledge/issues/new/choose): what you found and how to reproduce it, or what you are trying to do. [Write an issue we can build from](https://github.com/inkeep/open-knowledge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#write-an-issue-we-can-build-from) has a few tips.
